title: this / that / these / those
grammarNote: Эти слова называются "demonstrative pronouns" — указательные местоимения. Они помогают показать НА ЧТО ты говоришь: близко или далеко, один предмет или несколько. Используй их вместо слова "it" когда хочешь указать на конкретный предмет.

grammarTable.subject: this
grammarTable.example: This is my laptop. · What is this? · This book is heavy.

grammarTable.subject: that
grammarTable.example: That is my dictionary. · What is that? · That poster is beautiful.

grammarTable.subject: these
grammarTable.example: These are my pens. · These textbooks are new. · Are these yours?

grammarTable.subject: those
grammarTable.example: Those are my shoes. · Those mountains are amazing. · Whose are those?

rows.example: "Is this your bag?" — "Yes, it is. / No, it isn't."
this book · this room · this pen · this idea
that poster · that desk · that student · that city
these books · these pens · these students · these shoes
those mountains · those chairs · those textbooks

grammarExtra.title: this vs that — близко или далеко?

grammarTip:
Простая схема:
ОДИН предмет → this (рядом) / that (далеко)
НЕСКОЛЬКО предметов → these (рядом) / those (далеко)

Easy trick: THIS и THESE — оба с буквой «S» → оба рядом!
THAT и THOSE — оба без «S» в начале → оба далеко!

"Is this your pen?" — "Yes, it is." / "No, it isn't mine."

exercises.instruction: You are holding a pen. Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ is my favourite pen. I use it every day.
exercises.hint: You are holding it = it's near you → This (singular + near).

exercises.instruction: You see a building far away. Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ is the WKU library. It has 500,000 books.

exercises.instruction: Fill in: this, that, these or those.
exercises.text: ___ are my textbooks on the desk in front of me. (plural, near)
Look at ___ mountains far away! They are so beautiful.
"These is my laptop" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "These" is plural. "Laptop" is singular → use "This is my laptop."

exercises.text: ___ your earphones? (pointing at earphones near you on the table)
exercises.hint: Earphones = plural, near you → Are these your earphones?
